_comment: Host this on the client's web server at the portal root: https://<portal>/app-config.json . The app reads it on every launch, so everything here can change without shipping a new APK.
updateMessage: A new version is available with fixes and improvements.
maintenanceMessage: We are upgrading the system. Please try again in a few minutes.
_push: Push notifications. Copy these four out of the client's google-services.json (Firebase Console -> Project settings -> Your apps -> Android). They are read at run time, so push is switched on for a client by editing this file - no APK rebuild. Leave them blank and the app still works: alerts show in the in-app bell, just not in the phone's tray. The SERVER side needs the matching service-account JSON in appsettings 'FCM'.
